label: Thu Duc major landmarks road graph
landmark_definition: Named OSM features tagged as university/college, hospital, marketplace, bus station/townhall, mall, railway station, stadium, museum or theme park.
limitations: Only selected named major-place categories are exposed as selectable nodes.
Edges are derived aggregate shortest paths over the historic UTraffic road snapshot.
Traffic is historical, not real-time; flood risk 0 means NO_RECORD, not flood-safe.
Markers stay at OSM coordinates; straight POI-to-road connectors use a disclosed 20 km/h assumption.
Former Thu Duc City boundary is an OSM relation currently tagged historic.
The graph keeps four nearest outgoing road-path alternatives per landmark where available to improve detour choice without adding nodes.
LANDMARK_FLOOD and LANDMARK_CONGESTION use labelled ASSUMPTION edge overrides for demonstrations; they are not live measurements.
Hard closure scenarios apply to exact landmark edge IDs; they do not propagate to overlapping aggregate edges or source segments.
Academic visualization only; not navigation or safety guidance.
